# Bitterapple

> Free Mac DAW plugins and iOS/macOS apps by recording engineer Hiroshi Kojima.

## Main pages

- Home: https://bitterapple.github.io/
- Plugins: https://bitterapple.github.io/
- Apps: https://bitterapple.github.io/
- Harmony & Counterpoint: https://bitterapple.github.io/support/harmonycounterpoint/

## Products

- Harmony & Counterpoint: iPhone app for counterpoint assignments and figured-bass practice.
- Studio Mate: tools for timecode markers and PDF notes in recording sessions.
- CopySkipper: macOS utility for safer file copy workflows.
- BandMatrix: multiband dynamics plug-in with flexible routing.
- Spectral Leveler: real-time spectrogram dynamics tool.

## Support

- Contact: kjdevapphelp@gmail.com
